usefulness.rationale: The dossier establishes core identity (DAIR founder/executive director, former Google Ethical AI co-lead) and some of her ideas, but it is built almost entirely on a single podcast page source, so depth on her career, the firing circumstances, and her writing is thin. It correctly marks the "fired" and "paper" claims as claimed rather than asserted. It never flags what it does not know (no date-of-birth, education, or Black in AI details despite the identity anchor mentioning them), implying more completeness than it has. It is minimally conversation-ready: one could open a meeting knowing who she is, but there is little substantive or current material to prepare from. No overclaims found in the dossier statements; notably it avoids the unjustified conclusions about a current Google role and the DAIR team-size conflation.
